device_noise.approximation: Aer backend-derived gate-error and in-gate T1/T2 channels plus independent readout; no complete idle schedule, crosstalk or drift model. Aer may truncate T2 to 2*T1.

coverage.missing_calibration_policy: BLOCKED; no unlabelled perfect or FakeBackend fallback

device_noise.quantum_channel_representation: equivalent single Kraus instruction per local error
